purpose: Test whether block-31 terminal self-attention output mediates the fit-only word-audio-placeholder donor patch effect
system_prompt: Answer the spoken question with one color word.
upstream_patch: post-block layer-30 donor state at projected word-slot audio placeholder positions
sublayer_hooks: layer31.self_attn first output at terminal position
primary_endpoint: complete donor-color answer with normal EOS
interpretation_limit: A donor sublayer output is a broad activation patch, not an identified attention head. This is a posthoc fit-only mediation test; even a successful restore does not uniquely prove natural information flow.
